model_annotation:
Three cascading doughnut charts in this image depict the proportion of enterprises, employment, and net turnover in 2021 by industry, construction, trade, and services. 

The first chart, representing enterprises as a percentage of the total economy for 2021, shows construction with 14% and industry with 11%, followed by trade and services at 79% and 70% respectively. 

The second chart illustrates the number of persons employed for 2021. The majority of employment is in trade (51%), followed by construction (21%) and services (14%). Industry and trade are the smallest categories with 9% and 19% respectively. 

The third chart outlines the turnover for each sector in 2021. Industry has the highest turnover at 31%, while trade follows with 6%, construction and services have 31% and 10.6% respectively.
